summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a First Supplemental Indenture dated September 10, 2026 with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee, establishing two series of senior notes: US$500 million of 5.050% notes due 2031 and US$500 million of 5.650% notes due 2036. The legal opinion of Davis Polk & Wardwell is included, and exhibits are incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-3 shelf. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf, not a special situation; watch for use of proceeds and any leverage or buyback implications.
